mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(dic.area,0) as area,sum(rt.bps) bps ,#{push} time FROM( SELECT t.node_ip ip,sum(t.speed) bps from ( SELECT RECV_TIME,NODE_IP,INOCTETS_SPEED+OUTOCTETS_SPEED as speed FROM traffic_netflow_port_info where RECV_TIME >= #{start} and RECV_TIME < #{end} ) t GROUP BY ip ) rt LEFT JOIN (SELECT entrance_id area,manager_ip ip FROM ntc_device_info GROUP BY area,ip) dic on dic.ip = rt.ip GROUP BY dic.area
SELECT b.type,concat(#{ip},#{serverPort},b.url) url ,b.datetime time FROM( SELECT type ,max(id) id FROM image_url WHERE module = #{type} group by type) a LEFT JOIN image_url b ON a.id=b.id;
